title: USPP031822P3 - SEKOYA Grande 'FC13-122'
source_name: United States Patent and Trademark Office plant patent record
summary: United States plant patent granted 2020-06-02 on application filed 2019-01-10.
why_it_matters: A granted plant patent is a public registry record. It fixes ownership, priority dates and parentage, and its botanical description is prepared under a legal duty of accuracy, which makes it a stronger source for varietal identity than any marketing material.

reading.rationale: Registry records are the anchor for varietal identity across the whole dataset.

testing.rationale: Patent descriptions suggest comparison standards for trialling but are not trial data.

commercial_position.rationale: Patent coverage indicates which markets a breeder intends to defend.

monitoring.rationale: Grant status changes rarely; expiry dates matter on a multi-year horizon.
